grammarFocus: 让步与对比；关系从句；举例表达的多种形式。
title: Museum Visit and Cultural Discussion
instructions: 本材料为模拟练习，非官方雅思试题。听力部分包含一段对话，请先听录音（或阅读transcript），然后回答问题。阅读部分为passage，请阅读后回答问题。题目类型包括单选、填空、判断正误/未提及。填空答案必须与原文完全一致，且不超过字数限制。所有解释均为中文，并附原文证据。
transcript:
Mia: Hi, Tom! How was your visit to the new museum yesterday?
Tom: It was fascinating, though I have to admit, I almost didn't go because of the rain.
Mia: Really? I thought you loved museums.
Tom: I do, but the weather was terrible. Anyway, I'm glad I went. The exhibition on ancient Chinese inventions was incredible.
Mia: What did you like most?
Tom: Well, the display of early compasses was amazing. Although they were simple, they changed navigation completely.
Mia: That sounds interesting. Did they have any interactive parts?
Tom: Yes, there was a section where you could try using a replica of an old printing press. It was harder than it looked!
Mia: I bet. I heard the museum also has a new café.
Tom: That's right. The café, which opened last month, serves traditional snacks. I tried some, and they were delicious, even though they were a bit pricey.
Mia: Nice. I might go next weekend. Is it crowded on Saturdays?
Tom: It can be, but if you go early in the morning, it's usually quiet. Oh, and don't miss the temporary exhibit on silk road textiles. It's on the second floor.
Mia: Thanks for the tip. By the way, did you go with anyone?
Tom: No, I went alone, but I met a group of students from a local school. They were there for a project on cultural heritage.
Mia: That's cool. I wish I had more time to explore.
Tom: Me too. The museum is huge, and there's so much to see. I only covered about half of it.
Mia: Well, at least you have a reason to go back.
Tom: Exactly. Next time, I'll bring my sister, who is really into history.
Mia: Sounds like a plan. Let me know if you go again; I'd love to join.
Tom: Sure thing!

questions.prompt: Why did Tom almost not go to the museum?
questions.explanation: Tom说“I almost didn't go because of the rain.”，所以几乎没去的原因是下雨。
questions.evidence: I almost didn't go because of the rain.

questions.prompt: What did Tom find most impressive?
questions.explanation: Tom明确说“the display of early compasses was amazing”，并提到它们改变了航海。
questions.evidence: the display of early compasses was amazing.

questions.prompt: What does Tom say about the interactive printing press?
options: It was harder than it looked
answers: It was harder than it looked
questions.explanation: Tom说“It was harder than it looked!”，即比看起来难。
questions.evidence: It was harder than it looked!

questions.prompt: What is true about the café?
options: It is on the second floor
questions.explanation: Tom说“The café, which opened last month, serves traditional snacks.”，所以咖啡馆是上个月开的。
questions.evidence: The café, which opened last month, serves traditional snacks.

questions.prompt: Tom says the café serves ________ snacks. (one word)
According to Tom, when is the museum usually quiet?
questions.explanation: Tom说“if you go early in the morning, it's usually quiet.”，所以清晨通常安静。
questions.evidence: if you go early in the morning, it's usually quiet.

questions.prompt: Where is the temporary exhibit on silk road textiles?
questions.explanation: Tom说“It's on the second floor.”，指的是丝绸之路纺织品临时展览。

questions.prompt: Who did Tom meet at the museum?
questions.explanation: Tom说“I met a group of students from a local school.”，所以遇到了一群学生。
questions.evidence: I met a group of students from a local school.

questions.prompt: Tom says he covered about half of the museum.
questions.explanation: Tom说“I only covered about half of it.”，与题目一致。
questions.evidence: I only covered about half of it.

questions.prompt: Tom's sister has already visited the museum.
questions.explanation: Tom只提到下次会带妹妹去，但未说明妹妹是否已经去过博物馆。因此是Not Given。
questions.evidence: Next time, I'll bring my sister, who is really into history.

grammar.title: 让步与对比；关系从句；举例表达
grammar.explanation: 本对话中使用了让步状语从句（如although, even though, though），关系从句（如which opened last month, who is really into history），以及举例表达（如for example, such as）。让步状语从句表示“虽然，尽管”，关系从句用来补充说明名词，举例表达用于列举例子。
grammar.example: Although they were simple, they changed navigation completely.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with a concessive clause.
options: Although it was raining, we went out.
Because it was raining, we went out.
If it was raining, we went out.
So it was raining, we went out.
answers: Although it was raining, we went out.
questions.explanation: Although 引导让步状语从句，表示“虽然”。其他选项分别表示原因、条件、结果。
questions.evidence: Although they were simple, they changed navigation completely.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct relative clause to complete: The book, ________, is very popular.
questions.explanation: 先行词是物（book），关系代词用which。who用于人，where用于地点，when用于时间。
questions.evidence: The café, which opened last month, serves traditional snacks.

questions.prompt: Which phrase is used to give an example?
questions.explanation: such as 用于举例。because of 表示原因，in spite of 表示让步，as a result 表示结果。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with a non-defining relative clause.
options: My brother, who lives in Beijing, is a doctor.
My brother who lives in Beijing is a doctor.
My brother, which lives in Beijing, is a doctor.
My brother, where lives in Beijing, is a doctor.
answers: My brother, who lives in Beijing, is a doctor.
questions.explanation: 非限制性关系从句用逗号隔开，先行词是人用who。which用于物，where用于地点。
questions.evidence: Next time, I'll bring my sister, who is really into history.
